description: This delightful circular walk explores the area surrounding the charming Berkshire village of Waltham St Lawrence. The route features long stretches of tree-lined bridleways, offering picturesque views across open fields and woodlands. You'll pass through several small settlements, including West End, notable for its beautiful historic properties. The return journey then leads you through the expansive parkland of Shottesbrooke Park, where you can admire its grand mansion, mature trees, open pastures, a serene lake, and a quaint church. There's also an optional detour to nearby White Waltham on the eastern part of the walk. You can continue your walking along the Knowl Hill Bridleway. The shared cycling and walking route links up with this walk.
